answer_1.quote: We evaluate our method on 6 datasets spanning a variety of domains. For general-domain tasks, we use CommonsenseQA and SciQ for natural language understanding, as well as QNLI and MNLI for natural language inference. To assess question-answering performance in specialized domains, we include MedMCQA from the medical domain and Law from the legal domain.
